scheduleWizardPrompt:
/task-schedule

Start setting up a schedule.

Important: do not register it immediately. First ask the user focused questions to confirm intent, including:
- what to run
- why it should run and its purpose/description
- which project it belongs to
- when and how often it should run
- where results should be left
- whether the work is risky or needs confirmation
